test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 27 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Every cloud has a ______ lining.
solution:
The correct answer is** "silver". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Every cloud has a silver lining" **is a commonly used idiom in the English language.
 
• This idiom means that every difficult or sad situation has a comforting or more hopeful aspect, even though this may not be immediately apparent.
 
• The word **"silver" **specifically relates to the idiom and its intended meaning of finding hope or positive aspects in tough situations.
 
• Other options like **"diffused," "blue," **and **"grey" **do not fit into this idiom or carry the same meaning of optimism in the face of adversity.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Diffused"** means spread out over a large area; not concentrated, which doesn't fit the structure of the idiom.
 
• **"Blue" **often symbolizes sadness or depression in English, which contradicts the optimistic theme of the idiom.
 
• **"Grey" **could imply something dull or lacking in comfort, which again does not align with the hopeful message of the saying.
